import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a categorical plot to visualize the average sleep duration and quality of sleep by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
ax = sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Quality of Sleep', data=data, ci=None, palette='muted', edgecolor='w')

# Add axis labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (Hours)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Average Sleep Duration and Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=14)

# Add a legend
ax.legend(title='Quality of Sleep', loc='upper right')

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
